title: Political process and governance
purpose: Follow stated mandates, public commitments and documented participation; keep institutional remit separate from implementation.
questions: Which published commitments identify a responsible institution, consultation process and date?
Whose participation is documented, and whose participation remains a question for further research?

evidence.locator: Mandate text on the Syrian-led process and Security Council resolution 2254.
evidence.establishes: The office’s published institutional frame.

evidence.locator: Resolution metadata and adoption date, 18 December 2015.
evidence.establishes: A dated Security Council document; not a timetable of current implementation.

map_policy.geometry: Unpinned national or institutional card by default.
allow: Place of a documented meeting if explicitly named and dated.
exclude: Inferred governance boundaries
Assumed representation
Current electoral or constitutional status inferred from the 2015 resolution

candidate_output: A dated commitments table with issuer, exact document, affected question and follow-up reference.

title: Protection and accountability
purpose: Distinguish humanitarian monitoring, investigative findings, allegations and judicial decisions.
questions: What evidentiary standard and collection method does each source use?
Does a reference describe service access, an alleged violation, an investigative finding or a court ruling?

evidence.locator: Section I, Mandate and methodology, paragraphs 1–2.
evidence.establishes: The Commission’s methodology in a 9 February 2024 report covering July–December 2023.

reporting_period.label: PDF header January–September 2026; third-quarter narrative, with year-to-date metrics.

evidence.locator: PDF pp. 1–2 and 4–6.
evidence.establishes: Dated protection priorities, legal support and coordination reported by UNHCR.

map_policy.geometry: Reported areas or representative town points with scope labels.
allow: Regional monitoring context tied to the report’s methodology
exclude: Atrocity intensity heatmaps from mixed references
Current individual criminal liability
Unreviewed incident claims as established facts

candidate_output: A claim ledger displaying statement type, source, date, scope and review state.

title: Displacement and returns
purpose: Connect movement estimates to questions about documentation, housing, services and durable reintegration.
questions: Which figures are estimates, registrations, movements or surveyed households?
Which conditions of return are actually measured, and which remain unknown?

evidence.locator: Dashboard title, reference date and estimation note.
evidence.establishes: National estimates as of 29 October 2026 for movements since 8 December 2024.

evidence.locator: Methodology and regional synthesis sections.
evidence.establishes: Dated protection monitoring for April–June 2026; governorate coverage and representativeness require the report’s qualifications.

evidence.locator: PDF p. 2, civil-registry rehabilitation paragraph.
evidence.establishes: A reported documentation-support initiative in Nawa and Haran Al-Awamid.

map_policy.geometry: National aggregates unpinned; regional findings labelled by their actual coverage.
allow: Published aggregate boundaries if a licensed dataset is later obtained
exclude: Individual journeys
Inferred safe-return corridors
Treating a recorded return as proof of safety, voluntariness or permanence
Summing overlapping national and local totals

candidate_output: A returns-context panel with separate metric definitions and a service-access reading list.

title: Services and recovery
purpose: Track announced, started and reported-complete projects as distinct stages.
questions: Is the source an announcement, procurement step, implementation update or completion statement?
What evidence would show continuing access and outcomes after construction?

evidence.locator: Official completion announcement, 19 October 2026.
evidence.establishes: A reported eastern Aleppo water-supply project completion.

evidence.locator: Official launch announcement and stated July 2026–July 2028 implementation period.
evidence.establishes: A Homs urban-recovery and solid-waste project announcement, not completed outcomes.

evidence.locator: PDF p. 3, Al-Bab Vocational Training Centre paragraph.
evidence.establishes: Rehabilitation was reported as started.

reporting_period.label: PDF header January–September 2026; third-quarter narrative, with year-to-date metrics.

evidence.locator: PDF p. 2, community-based organization initiative examples.
evidence.establishes: A Douma community initiative is described; facility completion is not established.

map_policy.geometry: Town- or city-representative points, not precise facility geotags.
allow: Explicit status badges: announced / started / reported complete / not specified
exclude: Projected beneficiaries treated as measured users
Assumed present operation
A point implying service coverage across a whole governorate

title: Regional and international diplomacy
purpose: Organize public diplomatic references by issuer, venue, participants, stated aims and subsequent documents.
questions: Which statements report a meeting and which document an agreement?
Which follow-up sources would show implementation rather than diplomatic intent?

evidence.locator: Published mandate.
evidence.establishes: An institutional point of departure for political-process research.

title: Media and source ecology
purpose: Show what the selected outlets and institutions have published, where their references point and what topics they mention.
questions: Which topics and places occur in this explicitly bounded collection?
How does source type, language, document genre and collection method shape what is visible?

evidence.establishes: A selected English institutional-news framing.

evidence.locator: Headline and article body under the Paris dateline.
evidence.establishes: A same-publisher Arabic account of the reported meetings.

evidence.locator: Headline, standfirst and opening interviews.

allow: An edge that a source published a reference
A reviewed place mention tied to a field or locator
Counts of selected references with explicit denominator
exclude: Inferred media influence
Fabricated causal relationships
Ideological or reliability scores
Treating language versions as independent corroboration

title: Conflict evidence and civilian impact
purpose: Read conflict-related reporting through attribution, date, geography and civilian impact without constructing a tactical picture.
questions: Is a claim about a historical period, a newly reported allegation or a verified document finding?
What civilian effects are directly documented, and what location precision does the source actually support?

evidence.locator: Section I, paragraphs 1–2; historical reporting period July–December 2023.
evidence.establishes: A methodology reference, not evidence of present deployments.

evidence.locator: Regional synthesis and methodology sections.
evidence.establishes: Dated monitoring of protection concerns, with stated sample and geographic limitations.

map_policy.geometry: Source-dated reports and broad civilian-impact context.
allow: Separate unreviewed-reference list outside factual map layers
exclude: Current frontlines
Military positions
Real-time movement or targeting information
Automatic incident maps built from headlines
Maps of alleged actor control inferred from outlet coverage

candidate_output: A review queue with distinct fields for allegation, attribution, verification status and supported geographic scope.
